rows.notes: The study is a systematic literature review (Web of Science bibliometric analysis) of UAV-plus-deep-learning crop leaf disease studies. It reports no own experiment, dataset, survey or model runs; all accuracy figures (F1-scores, OA, mAP, R2) are tabulated from the cited primary studies. Its only original 'data' are publication counts, country distributions and SDG tagging from the database query. It therefore cannot provide primary evidence that deep models detect or grade infections before canopy-wide symptoms or enable targeted responses; it only summarises other work.
